recon.extraction_guidance: PRIMARY TARGET: Table 6 for foliar mineral concentrations. Extract each species-site combination separately: (1) Duke P. taeda 0-year needles, (2) Duke P. taeda 1-year needles, (3) Duke L. styraciflua, (4) ORNL L. styraciflua, (5) SERC Q. chapmanii, (6) SERC Q. geminata, (7) SERC Q. myrtifolia. Use A=control, E=treatment. Note units carefully: Al, Cu, Fe, Mn, Ni, Zn are in lg/g (ug/g); Co, Pb, V, Mo are in ng/g. Errors are SE. For Duke P. taeda, CO2 levels are 382 (ambient) vs 582 ppm (elevated); for ORNL 393 vs 549 ppm; for SERC ambient vs ambient+350 ppm. Sample sizes: Duke n=3/treatment, ORNL n=3 ambient/n=2 elevated, SERC n=8/treatment. Values in Table 6 are averaged across canopy heights - do not attempt to extract canopy-height-specific values from this table (those are only in Figures 4 and 5 as graphical data). SECONDARY: Table 2 contains soil metal data if soil concentrations are within meta-analysis scope.
